howToApply: Visit the Online Application Portal of AEES at https://aees.onlineregistrationforms.com
Register and create a valid account using a personal email ID and mobile number.
Fill in the online application form carefully with correct details (name, date of birth, category, etc. as per Class X certificate).
Upload scanned copies of required documents (photograph, signature, certificates, etc.) using a proper scanner.
Select the post(s) for which you wish to apply. Within PGTs, apply for only one subject; within TGTs, apply for only one subject.
Pay the application fee and processing fee online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking.
Submit the application form and generate the Confirmation Page. Keep a printout for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to AEES by post. Bring it at the time of Skill Test/Interview along with self-attested copies of certificates.

dates.event: Last Date to Apply & Pay Examination Fee

howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.

title: DMRC Recruitment 2026 – Senior Engineer, Supervisor, Engineer Posts
shortInfo: DMRC has announced notification for Senior Engineer, Supervisor, Engineer posts. Required qualification: Govt Org/Railways/PSUs/Metro exp in Arch, Civil, Env, Signaling. Last date to apply: 04-11-26.

dates.event: Last Date of Receipt of Application
Shortlisted Candidates List Upload (Tentative) (Second Week of November, 2026)
Final Result Declaration (Tentative) (Fourth Week of November, 2026)

howToApply: Download the application form from the DMRC website: http://www.delhimetrorail.com
Fill in the application form (Annexure-I) in capital letters with all required details.

Attach all relevant documents including educational certificates, work experience certificates, last promotion order, copy of PPO, NOC from present employer, D&AR and Vigilance clearance (Annexure-II), and APARs of last 05 years.
Candidates presently employed in Govt. organization/Railways/PSUs/Metro organizations must send their application through proper channel along with Vigilance and D&AR clearance.

Send the duly filled application form in an envelope superscribing the Name of Post prominently, through Speed Post to: Additional General Manager/HR/P, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Fire Brigade Lane, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi, latest by 04/11/2026.

OR email the scanned copy of duly filled Application Form along with scanned copies of all other documents to: career@dmrc.org, indicating the Advt. No. DMRC/PERS/22/HR/2026/235 in the subject of the email.
Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date shall be summarily rejected.
